Keep both hands in view. Use 1.5× for a distant signer.
Hand not visible for most of the capture
This capture was not clear enough to read. Keep both hands inside the guide for the whole capture, then try again.
Perform one sign, then tap Finish
This recording is longer than most signs. Tap Finish as soon as the sign ends — extra time is trimmed, but a long wait makes the reading less reliable.
Signing now. Cancel discards this recording without recognising anything.
That recording was too short to read. Start, perform the whole sign, then finish.
The camera did not send any frames during that recording. Try again.
The camera stopped during that sign. Hold still for a moment, then record again.
Hands were visible for too little of that recording. Keep both hands in the guide while you sign.
Switch between front and back camera
Keep both hands inside the frame guide and try again.
Not enough of the sign was recorded yet. Perform the whole sign, then tap straight away.
The camera stopped sending frames during that sign. Hold still for a moment, then sign again.
That sign was just read. Pause a moment, perform the next sign, then tap again.
Something interrupted recognition. You can try again.
EchoGesture reads hand landmarks from the camera. Frames are processed on this device and never leave it.
The camera could not start. Close other apps using the camera and try again.
The recognition models could not load. Restart the app.
Recognition failed for this capture. Try again.
Best match — still confirm before relying on it
Your hands were visible too briefly to confirm this match. Keep them in frame for the whole sign.
Your hands look small in the picture. Move closer, keep the whole sign in view, and try again.
Low confidence. Compare the options below or try the sign on its own.
That sign was too short to read. Perform the whole sign once the app says it is ready.
No sign started. Tap Start Recognition and perform one sign.
The camera stopped delivering frames. Try the sign again.
Capture reached its time limit. Try one shorter sign.
That attempt could not be read. Try again with the whole sign inside the guide.
A model score ranks the 100 known signs; it is not a calibrated probability that the reading is correct. Recognises one isolated sign at a time.
Could not play the sign aloud
These are the model’s output class names. They identify which sign was recognised, not a full description of the sign’s meaning or grammar.
Kept in memory for this session only
Recognise a sign on the Camera tab and it will appear here.

Used when the app opens the camera
Show the hand-placement guide over the preview
Short vibration on capture, result and error
Size of the recognised sign on the result card
Read confirmed signs aloud in English
When off, history is kept in memory and cleared when the app closes. No video is ever stored.
Records frame counts, capture timing and hand-presence flags for a consented test session. No images, no landmarks, no identifiers; nothing leaves the device. Turning this off deletes the record.
Camera frames never leave this device.
This app does not request the internet permission.
No video or images are saved.
No diagnostics recorded yet. Turn on Capture diagnostics, perform a sign, then export.
Recognises one isolated sign at a time from a fixed 100-sign vocabulary. It is not a sentence translator and does not replace a human interpreter.
Hand tracking by Google MediaPipe (Apache-2.0). Model and app by the EchoGesture team.
Tap Start Recognition with your hands lowered. Perform one sign and wait for the result. Tap Scan next sign to repeat. Check the Glossary for the 100 supported ASL signs.
Point the camera so the signer’s hands are clearly visible.
Keep both hands inside the frame guide.
Lower your hands, tap Start Recognition, and perform one supported ASL sign. Pause briefly at the end or lower your hands. The result appears automatically.
Keep both hands in view for the whole sign. If the recording is too short or shows no hands, the app says so instead of guessing.
Check the match and tap Scan next sign for each new sign. Use a separate video for each sign when importing clips.
Everything runs on this phone. Nothing is uploaded.
All inference runs on this device.
Raw camera frames are never uploaded or stored.
History is session-only unless you turn on saving.
The app has no internet permission and cannot open a network connection.
Could not read this video. Choose a different clip.
